title: Coherent universal coefficient arrows on etale source sites
statement: For a scheme Y, coefficient homomorphism q:R→S and a specified arrow d:C→Res_q Cprime in fixed-module etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows], define etaleNormalizationCoefficients as the exact localization of the canonical inverse-image/coefficient mate. EtaleUniversalNormalization Y q d means: on every etale Y-object U the specified etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow [def-weil-pbc-etale-isomorphism-normalization-arrow] is universal in its structured-arrow category; for every f:U→V the pulled normalization arrow, conjugated by localIsomorphismRestrictionComp [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf], equals the normalization arrow on U via that same canonical coefficient mate. No map of Isom presheaves is part of this property.
